column1: # Generated meshes for stream AG (docs/research.md §28). Never committed:
# bun bench/generated/fetch.ts DIR downloads them and checks the SHA-256.
# Columns (tab-separated): name, generator, category, licence, URL, zip
# member(s) (";" between several; "-" for a plain file), SHA-256 (per member).
# Hi3DBench (3DTopia, NeurIPS 2025 datasets track, MIT): outputs of
# image-to-3D models on 3DGen-Bench's image prompts, generated by the
# benchmark's authors. The same six prompts (ids 5, 30, 120, 300, 420, 480)
# for every generator. Meshy: MESHY.AI 800 GLB 3D-Assets (curated by tfnn
# from Meshy users' published generations, MIT as published; Meshy's own
# terms put free-tier outputs under CC BY 4.0, which also allows this use).
